segments.an10.212:1.1: “Dasahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an10.212:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti luddo lohitapāṇi hatapahate niviṭṭho adayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtesu.
segments.an10.212:2.1: “Adinnādāyī hoti … kāmesumicchācārī hoti … musāvādī hoti … pisuṇavāco hoti … pharusavāco hoti … samphappalāpī hoti … abhijjhālu hoti … byāpannacitto hoti … micchādiṭṭhiko hoti viparītadassano –
segments.an10.212:2.10: ‘natthi dinnaṃ … pe … sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
segments.an10.212:2.12: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an10.212:3.1: “Dasahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
segments.an10.212:3.3: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno, sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati.
segments.an10.212:4.1: “Adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti … kāmesumicchācāraṃ pahāya kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato hoti … musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato hoti … pisuṇaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti … pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti … samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti … anabhijjhālu hoti … abyāpannacitto hoti … sammādiṭṭhiko hoti aviparītadassano –
segments.an10.212:4.10: ‘atthi dinnaṃ … pe … ye imañca lokaṃ parañca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
segments.an10.212:4.11: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, dasahi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge”ti.
